snippet.title: Arcade Game: Time Pilot '84 (1984 Konami)
snippet.description:
An eight-way scrolling shooting 'em up game sequel to the original 1982 game where stages are set to over different time periods with different backgrounds as players must destroy a number of new enemy ships resulting an end level guardian appears.  Once that's destroyed, the player warp's to the next level. The player's ship is armed with forward firing gun and and infinite number of homing missiles. Each stage has green and metallic enemies. You can destroy green enemies with the standard gun but both metallic enemies and the end-of-stage guardian can only be killed with homing missiles. When the player gets close to metallic enemy, a lock-on square will appear over it, you hit it with a homing missile which will follow and hit and destroy the metallic enemy.

Note: Used Invincibility cheat down to last life. The game is endless so I quit afterwards.
